prompt:
Generate two reusable dark-fantasy game UI assets side by side on a true transparent background, isolated by generous transparent gutters. Reference 1 is the material/style reference for the Stock crate; reference 2 gives the matching wood-and-brass output plate style. Keep this same hand-painted miniature BG2/Diablo2 quality, dark walnut, worn golden brass corner straps and subtle ivory highlights. This is not a whole card. Exactly TWO components. NO lettering, numbers, UI labels, scenery or background.
LEFT COMPONENT: compact STOCK CRATE with a clearly SQUARE FRONT NUMBER FACE, front-facing so the number face is not angled or squeezed. A small amount of three-quarter depth only at the TOP and RIGHT sides shows that it is a crate. The front recess is smooth opaque nearly black charcoal/slate, intentionally quiet and blank to hold very large numeric text. The FRONT face itself has equal width and height. Recess occupies 80 percent of front face width and height; keep the wood boards and brass straps slim, not chunky. Small riveted corner hardware, matching the references. The crate's whole silhouette ratio approx 1:1.15 (slightly taller due to visible lid). The blank number face should dominate this object, not the lid.
RIGHT COMPONENT: a SQUARE STOCK OUTPUT NUMBER PLAQUE, orthographic front view. Equal width and height. It looks like the front face of the SAME crate: thin walnut plank edging, matching four brass corner straps with rivets, same very dark smooth empty square number recess. No perspective top/right depth on this plaque. Its number recess is at least 80 percent of width and height, spacious for a very large live numeral. Keep corner hardware restrained so text is the focus.
Two full independent isolated sprites, matching scale and construction. Real alpha transparency outside silhouettes, opaque dark inside number recesses. No baked numbers. No circular decorations. No extra components.
notes: Prototype only. Squarer Stock count/output recesses for larger live numbers. Original generated RGBA preserved.
